Your first visit, thoughtfully planned.

A practical guide to getting ready for your visit to West Gray Dental.

01

Before you arrive

Call the office to confirm your appointment, the dentist you will see, and how much time to allow. Let the team know if you have recent dental records or X-rays.

02

Bring your questions

Think about what you would like to discuss: day-to-day comfort, your smile, or a specific concern. Bring your insurance details if applicable, and ask the office which forms to complete.

03

Understand your options

The practice’s published first-visit information describes an examination and a conversation about your dental needs. Ask your dentist about your options and ask the office about estimated costs before making a treatment decision.
